reason: I do the billing myself every month, so I reckon I'd already know if I was leaking much, and pulling exports out of the PSA and billing system plus digging out contract PDFs is an afternoon I haven't got. I might have a go at the free audit on a quiet Friday, but I wouldn't pay £99 a month to keep uploading CSVs by hand.
objection: With no PSA integration it's on me to export everything every time, and on a demo MSP it found about £700 a month across 15 clients, which for my size is one ticket I'd probably write off anyway.
would_change_my_mind: A direct integration with my PSA so it runs without me exporting anything, and then a free audit that turns up real money I can bill, with the ticket to back it, that I'd genuinely missed.
